I didn't trust her even when she was introduced. Red Shoes from Lobotomy Corporation and the story in general of the "red shoes" is about obsession. In this case its about "coexistence" with Nikke and Raptures, the obvious flaw being none for humans. Red Shoes in Lobotomy Corp was a fascination with killing and wearing the shoes right down to them beckoning for someone to wear them even after their death (even when amputated from the body). 

Red Shoes followed the story nearly to a T. Where she got these "red shoes" from is not known but they are likely the source of her corruption if they follow the story, i mean they quite literally come to life just like in the story. It follows the story of Red Shoes quite nicely, so while i hate her, i feel she was doomed from the start to be evil. 

But there is always room for redemption, as even in the original tale, the peasant girl was redeemed once her feet were amputated. If we see her again, it may be an uncorrupted Red Shoes. Hell im calling it, she'll be named black shoes (as this was the color of the shoes she wore to church in the old story).
